title: IBM Storage Copy Data Management 2.2 could allow an authenticated user to execute arbitrary commands with normal user…
description: IBM Storage Copy Data Management 2.2 contains a vulnerability that allows an authenticated user to execute arbitrary commands with normal user privileges due to improper validation of user-supplied input. This flaw could lead to limited confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.3.
